end.parentNote: Asha practised position words using objects and picture descriptions, including “upar/neeche,” near/far, and inside/outside. Shaurya gave several correct descriptions such as the cat being under the pot and near the mat. Left and right were briefly mixed up as fixed room places; Asha revisited the idea with the person’s facing direction, and it was corrected later. At home, place two toys in different spots and ask, “Which is on top, under, near, far, inside, or outside?”
